subject: Renewal & top-up request — Glacier AI: accelerator pool add-on + pricing exception
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marsh <elena@glacier-ai.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the renewal conversation last week. Attached is an updated renewal proposal that includes the 12x A100 reserved add-on you asked about, plus an optional 24x accelerator pool priced as a top-up line item (see tab 2 in the XLS). Highlights: 
- 12x A100 reserved (baseline renewal): unchanged pricing per prior term
- Optional 24x A100 top-up: quoted as a 12-month reserved pool with throughput guidance and an optional SLA addendum
- Suggested concession: one-time onboarding credit of $30,000 for migration support if signed by Nov 30

Files attached: Glacier_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf, Throughput_SLA_Draft.xlsx

If you want to pursue the 24x pool, tell me whether procurement needs PO/DocuSign or if your legal prefers a separate SLA addendum. I'll pull the pricing team in for any credit requests.

Best,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187
From: Elena Marsh <elena@glacier-ai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up

Laura —

Thanks for the proposal, this is helpful. Quick notes from our side after an internal capacity forecast: we actually need the full 24x A100 reserved pool (not optional) and we need a throughput SLA (target 99.9% p95 request availability during business hours). Two asks from procurement and finance: 
1) Can Redwood provide a one-time credit to offset migration and driver optimization — we were thinking $45k.
2) Given the size, is there a multi-year discount (24 months) you can offer on the top-up pool?

Procurement is cc'd (procurement@glacier-ai.com) and will want draft contract language and a PO once we agree terms. We can move fast if pricing/credit are approved.

Best,
Elena
Head of Platform Ops | Glacier AI
elena@glacier-ai.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up — Glacier asks for $45k credit + 24-month term

Team —

Looping you in. Glacier is converting the optional 24x pool to a required top-up and is requesting: 
- One-time onboarding credit: $45,000
- Multi-year (24-month) pricing on the 24x pool
- Throughput SLA: 99.9% p95 during business hours

Context: they are a steady mid-enterprise customer with growing inference usage across two product lines; this expansion materially increases committed GPU spend. They indicated they’ll sign quickly if we approve the credit and term.

Questions: 
- Marcus / finance: is $45k in-line with concession guidelines for this ARR uplift? If not, what floor can you approve without exec?
- Stephanie / sales leadership: do you want to escalate to exec for a higher credit?
- Aditya: any concerns from an operational SLA perspective on throughput guarantees for a 24x pool (we can route to dedicated pools and autoscale policies)?

I attached the proposal and SLA draft. Please advise — procurement is asking for a decision this week.

Thanks,
Laura
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up — Glacier asks for $45k credit + 24-month term

Laura / team —

Finance view: the expansion looks to add ~$1.1M ARR if they commit for 12 months at the quoted rates; a 24-month commit would be ~ $2.0M. Given uplift, a concession is reasonable. My recommended options: 

Option A (no exec): approve up to $30k one-time onboarding credit if they sign for 12 months and meet the payment terms (30 days net).
Option B (sales escalates): approve up to $40k if they sign 24 months with 50% upfront on year one.
Option C (exec required): full $45k credit for 24 months with standard refund/recoup clause if they churn within 12 months.

Risk/controls: tie the credit to milestone (PO + first invoice paid) and require legal to include audit clause for usage verification. Also note throughput SLA will need an operational guardrail: auto-fallback to a compatible lower-tier model with notice, and a capacity failover in region. Aditya, can you confirm feasibility and whether we need an SRE runbook?

-Marcus
Finance Director | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up — Glacier asks for $45k credit + 24-month term

Team —

Operational note: 24x A100 reserved pool with a 99.9% p95 throughput SLA during business hours is feasible in our Dedicated offering, but we need: 
- An explicit failover policy in the SLA (region fallback and model variant fallback)
- A runbook for capacity pre-warming and increased KV cache reservations to hit p95 targets
- A rollout plan for the first 30 days including a test window (we should include a 2-week ramp with telemetry)

If finance wants a $40k concession for 24 months with 50% upfront we can accept, provided legal signs an SLA addendum that captures the fallbacks above. If they push for $45k, I want a short operational change window and a small ramping credit holdback until 60 days of telemetry looks clean.

Happy to draft the SLAs and runbook with SRE and send to Elena once pricing approved.

-Aditya
Sr. Director, Production Services | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Marsh <elena@glacier-ai.com>, procurement@glacier-ai.com
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal & optional accelerator pool top-up — final terms for approval

Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and for looping procurement. Quick update on approvals: 
- Finance (Marcus) can approve a $40,000 one-time onboarding credit if Glacier signs a 24-month term and pays 50% of year one upfront.
- Operations (Aditya) confirms feasibility with the SLA guardrails (failover, 2-week ramp, 60-day telemetry holdback if needed).
- Legal will prepare a short SLA addendum capturing the throughput guarantee, failover language, and the recoup clause for the credit.

If that works for Glacier, we'll issue an updated proposal and DocuSign package today; procurement can issue PO_43821 when ready.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the $40k credit + 24 months with 50% upfront by end of EOD Monday, Nov 9, so we can lock capacity and sign. Once confirmed I’ll send the DocuSign link and the SLA draft.

Best,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_43821.pdf (placeholder for customer's PO when sent)
